description:

• Ability to travel as needed, up to 30%.

• Master’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Industrial-Organizational Psychology or related field.

title: Contract Manufacturing Business Development Manager
description:

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER
Medical Device Contract Manufacturing | Remote/Field-Based | Reports to Director of Commercial Operations

ClearPath Medical is a U.S.-based medical device contract manufacturer specializing in custom cable assemblies, electromechanical assemblies, and precision manufacturing for Class II and Class III OEM customers. We're growing and adding our first dedicated hunter to bring new OEM logos into the business.
This is a pure new-account role. You will not be handed a retention book. We expect you to arrive with OEM relationships built while representing another outsourced manufacturing or services provider, and to open doors with existing contacts immediately upon joining.
What you'll do

• Identify, prospect, and close new OEM accounts with potential to scale to $1M+ in annual production volume

• Build and own your pipeline from first contact through signed production agreement

• Serve as primary customer contact through onboarding and early production ramp, coordinating with Engineering, Quality, and Production

• Maintain a clean pipeline in HubSpot and participate in weekly pipeline reviews

• Feed competitive and market intelligence back to leadership

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Required:

• 5+ years selling to medical device OEM companies, calling on R&D, engineering, or sourcing functions

• Current or recent experience at a CDMO or contract manufacturer where you've sold PCB assembly, injection-molded components, cable assemblies, electromechanical contract assembly, or similar services to OEM engineering and sourcing teams

• You have OEM relationships you're ready to activate: able to open doors with existing contacts immediately upon joining

• Comfortable with 6-18 month technical sales cycles: RFQ, NRE, design transfer, production ramp

• Working familiarity with FDA and ISO 13485 expectations in a contract manufacturing context

• HubSpot proficiency (or equivalent CRM)

Preferred:

• Background at a company like Integer, Viant, Resonetics, Lake Region Medical, API Technologies, or a comparable medical-manufacturing CDMO

• Existing relationships in cable/interconnect, electromechanical assembly, or precision machining

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or a related field (not required)

COMPENSATION
$90,000-$110,000 base salary depending on location and experience, plus uncapped commission on production revenue from accounts you originate and new account performance bonuses.
We provide a guaranteed first-year compensation structure to support the longer sales cycle typical of medical device contract design and manufacturing. We cover full commission and bonus mechanics during the interview process.
LOGISTICS

• Location: Remote/Field-Based; open to candidates anywhere in the U.S. with strong OEM access

• Travel: 30-40% estimated (customer sites, trade shows, periodic visits to Tustin, CA headquarters)

• No relocation requirement; regular Tustin presence not expected after onboarding

• Mileage/auto allowance provided

• Benefits: medical, dental, vision, paid time off

ABOUT CLEARPATH MEDICAL
ClearPath Medical is a U.S.-based medical device contract manufacturer with deep capabilities in custom cable assemblies, electromechanical assemblies, and precision manufacturing for leading OEM customers. Our integrated team spans production, quality, engineering, and supply chain, built to take on complex, high-value programs for Class II and Class III medical device OEMs. We offer a collaborative culture, entrepreneurial environment, and the opportunity to build a book of business from the ground floor of our next growth phase.

title: Facility Operator

ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands

.

title: Senior Solutions Architect – Large Scale AI Inference
description:
We are looking for a Senior Solutions Architect with deep experience in large-scale production AI inference. You will collaborate with top EMEA AI Natives, AI infrastructure providers, and enterprises deploying AI at scale. As a trusted technical leader, you will ensure NVIDIA 's inference stack achieves best performance, efficiency, and reliability. You will address the industry's toughest AI inference challenges at the intersection of AI and high-performance computing, driving innovations in areas such as multi-node Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving, interconnect-aware scheduling, memory-bound workload optimization, and next-generation inference architectures. Your work will establish the technical direction for scalable, high-performance AI inference across the most demanding production environments.
What you will be doing:

• Guide EMEA AI Natives customers in deploying and optimizing large-scale inference workloads on multi-node GPU clusters.

• Architect efficient inference pipelines for dense and sparse/latent MoE models distributing workload among thousands of GPUs.

• Improve inference efficiency across quantization (INT4/FP8), speculative decoding, disaggregated prefill/decode, KV cache management, and WideEP for large MoE deployments.

• Collaborate with NVIDIA product teams (Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, NIXL) to accelerate customer success.

• Animate the AI inference developer’s community across EMEA through technical workshops, hackathons, and reference architectures.

What we need to see

• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, High-Performance Computing, or equivalent professional experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Neural Networks inference optimization.

• Solid understanding of transformers inference optimization: quantization, disaggregated inference, speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV cache optimization.

• Practical experience in MoE inference at scale: expert parallelism, WideEP, all-to-all communication, routing overhead, and load balancing at scale.

• Ability to engage effectively with ML engineers, researchers, and systems architects at a deep technical level.

• Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Dynamo, NIXL, Grove, or emerging disaggregated inference tooling.

• Understanding of GPU memory hierarchies and high-speed interconnects (NVLink, InfiniBand, RDMA, UCX).

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

title: Principal Product Manager- Activation
description:
At Evolve , we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability-working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role
Evolve is on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone, and that starts with the homeowners who trust us with their properties. Signing with Evolve is only the start. Before an owner earns a dollar, their home has to be set up, photographed, permitted, priced and listed - and every one of those steps is a place where owners stall or drop off.
As Principal Product Manager for Activation, you'll own that journey, from signed agreement to a live, bookable listing. You'll be measured on how many owners go live, how quickly, and whether they're still with us six months later - not just on activation volume. The levers are known and largely unowned today: property setup, photo scheduling, permits and compliance, rates, and multi-property onboarding. Your job is to turn them into a roadmap and move the number.
The team
Growth owns Evolve 's owner-acquisition funnel, from first impression through qualified lead and signup, and all of our marketing. This role extends Growth's product work past signup into activation, working side by side with the Onboarding team that runs the process today.
What you’ll do

• Strategy & Roadmap

• Own the product roadmap from signed agreement to a live, bookable listing, with activation rate, time to live and 180-day retained activations as the measures of success

• Find where owners stall - property setup, photo scheduling, permits, rates, multi-property onboarding - and decide what to fix first and how

• Build & Experiment

• Ship product changes that take manual steps out of onboarding, from self-serve setup to automated scheduling and reminders

• Run experiments end to end: write the hypothesis, scope the build, measure the result, make the call

• Own activation instrumentation with analytics, so every step from signup to live can be measured by cohort

• Partnership

• Work closely with Onboarding and Operations, who run the process today, to change the system underneath it rather than adding more manual work

• Partner with Lifecycle Marketing on the onboarding journey and with the Funnel Conversion PM on the handoff at signup

• Talk to owners - single-property and portfolio - and turn what you learn into product decisions

What makes you a great fit

• 8+ years of product management, with meaningful time owning onboarding, activation or time-to-value

• Experience in a two-sided marketplace or operations-heavy business, ideally on the supply or seller side

• A track record of moving activation, conversion or early retention metrics, with the experiments to show for it

• Experience partnering with operations or field teams to automate manual processes

• Strong SQL and hands-on with product analytics tools like Amplitude - you build your own funnels and cohorts

• Comfortable at the spec level with engineers, and able to take products from discovery through launch and iteration

• AI-native working style - you use tools like Claude or Cursor in your daily work for specs, research synthesis and analysis; this is a baseline here, not a differentiator

• Nice to have: experience with compliance-heavy or regulated onboarding (permits, licensing or credentialing), with vacation rental, real estate, hospitality or property management, and with multi-property or business customers alongside individual ones

Compensation
Annual base salary range: $190,000 - $210,000 depending on relevant experience. This role will also be eligible to receive a variable annual b

title: Staff/Principal Engineer, Search & Retrieval
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is building the infrastructure for autonomous science: AI systems that design experiments, run them in physical labs, and close the loop across life sciences, chemistry, and materials science. Our platform enables this to operate reliably at scale for external customers who require security, auditability, and operational rigor.

We're hiring a Staff/Principal Engineer, Search & Retrieval (Enterprise AI) to own how scientists and agents ask questions of scientific knowledge at Lila: published literature and patents, customer-supplied documents, lab protocols, and the structured experimental record.

Your work will involve building RAG over unstructured text and a scientific knowledge graph that links literature to the structured experimental record.

Enterprise customers require one retrieval platform that any scientific workload can build on, with tenancy enforced in the index and the graph rather than the application layer. You will own that stack end to end, from ingestion to retrieval to cited answers a scientist can trace back to the evidence.

This is a deeply technical senior individual contributor role. We move fast, ship often, and look for engineers who do well with ambiguity and enjoy shaping the problem as much as solving it.

What You'll Be Building

• Technical leadership across platform engineering, infrastructure, AI/ML, and scientific teams. Broad architectural influence, high autonomy, direct ownership of critical platform systems.

• Define the shared retrieval foundation. Your architecture decisions become the default for scientific workloads across the company, well beyond the first one you ship.

• Knowledge graph and graph retrieval. Build one scientific knowledge graph from literature and the structured experimental record. Own graph retrieval and its fusion with vector and lexical search into a single cited answer.

• Agentic search. Build the autonomous research loop, from query planning through retrieval to traceable reasoning.

• Retrieval quality. Own the retrieval pipeline end to end and the evaluation harness.

• Ingestion and extraction. Own the pipeline that turns the many types of scientific data (PDFs, patents, lab protocols, and more) into semantically searchable evidence.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 8+ years of software development experience, including production ownership of a search, retrieval, RAG, or knowledge graph system that real users depended on.

• Production experience building semantic search: embedding models, vector indexes (HNSW/IVF), hybrid lexical and vector retrieval, and reranking. Graph database experience is a strong plus.

• Track record in high-growth environments where speed-to-value mattered as much as long-term architecture.

• You can describe how you measured retrieval quality (recall, groundedness, citation accuracy) and how you caught regressions.

• Hands-on coding in Python and modern backend frameworks (FastAPI, async Python).

• Modern cloud-native architectures (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS).

• Strong cross-functional communication and the ability to influence architecture across teams.

• BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points For

• Shipped RAG or semantic search in a regulated or enterprise context, through security and compliance review under regimes such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GxP (including ALCOA+ data integrity), or FedRAMP.

• Permission-aware retrieval over access-controlled data.

• Document understanding at scale: OCR, layout-aware parsing, table and figure extraction from scientific literature.

• Agentic retrieval and GraphRAG patterns, and how to evaluate them.

• Platforms serving scientific or laboratory data such as LIMS, ELN, bioinformatics, or materials informatics, with an understanding of provenance and traceability requirements.

• Domain-specific corpora and scientific ontologies (UMLS, MeSH, ChEBI, GO, UniProt, Materials Project) w

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. You'll turn customer demand into a product that customers can adopt, build on, and capture value from. You'll balance new capabilities against the reliability, security, and scale that production builds on Harvey require.

You'll define and drive the product vision and roadmap for Harvey's APIs, aligned with company strategy and grounded in evidence from customers, usage data, and the market. $213,600 - $300,000 USD

The Senior Claims Adjuster independently manages complex, high-exposure, and litigated Workers’ Compensation lost-time claims in assigned jurisdictions, including Pennsylvania, Delaware, and New Jersey. The role applies advanced compensability, medical, disability, reserving, litigation, settlement, and regulatory knowledge to develop and execute claim strategies through timely and cost-effective resolution. The Senior Claims Adjuster also serves as a technical resource, supports client relationships, mentors developing adjusters, and contributes to claim quality and continuous improvement initiatives.
Role Distinction
This is an advanced individual-contributor position. The Senior Claims Adjuster is expected to perform the complete Lost Time Adjuster role independently while demonstrating broader technical judgment, ownership of complex files, client-facing capability, mentoring, and measurable contribution to team performance. The position does not include formal supervisory authority unless separately assigned.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. At Rohlik Group, we are building the future of e-grocery for over a million active customers across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania. We own our entire technology stack - from storefronts and apps to automated fulfillment centers and last-mile logistics.

Within the Customer Experience (CUEX) domain, we own every touchpoint a customer interacts with, from the homepage to checkout and real-time order tracking across web, iOS, and Android. Our five storefronts run on a single product spine with localized content, pricing, and brand layers. We operate as a deliberately tight-knit, high-performing team where a Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, two Product Designers, and a dedicated full-stack engineering team ship fast, iterate constantly, and take full ownership of the end-to-end user journey.

Most interface failures in e-commerce aren’t layout issues - they are communication problems: what is said, in what order, and on which screen. As Senior Product Design Engineer, you will own the end-to-end design of all customer-facing surfaces across five markets. You will also manage our design system, Maia (our AI shopping assistant), and provide the design guidance that powers our automated coding workflows.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- High-impact Group scope: Design every customer-facing touchpoint across web, iOS, and Android for five international markets, impacting millions of orders.

- True end-to-end ownership: Lead the complete lifecycle of product design - from initial problem definition and customer research to shipped A/B tests and real-world performance analysis.

- AI-first execution: Rohlik is an AI-first company. You’ll own the interface design for Maia, our AI shopping assistant, and build the structured design system guidance used by AI coding agents to generate on-brand code without hand-coding interfaces.

- Direct customer engagement: Lead user research and usability testing sessions directly with real shoppers, rather than commissioning external agencies or receiving filtered insights.

- High accountability, low overhead: Work in a small, autonomous team where design decisions move straight to production and work that doesn't deliver measured impact is honestly reverted.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN AND DELIVER

- Customer Surfaces: Own the end-to-end design and UX strategy across web, iOS, and Android for all core journey stages: homepage, search & browse, product pages, basket, slot selection, checkout, and order tracking.

- Design System as a Product: Own component architecture, design tokens, patterns, and documentation, ensuring our coding agents have precise design guidance to generate accurate interfaces.

- AI Experience Design: Define the interaction patterns for Maia (our AI shopping assistant), governing when it intervenes, how it presents information, and how it hands over to human support.

- Experimentation & Analysis: Drive hypotheses, prototype rapidly, and evaluate A/B test results objectively - scaling successful experiments and sunsetting features that miss target performance.

- Direct User Research: Conduct qualitative interviews, usability tests, and field research directly with customers to continuously uncover friction points.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, and your peer product designer, while providing design input to Commercial, Marketing, and Operations.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products with a strong portfolio of shipped work across both web and native mobile (iOS and Android).

- Advanced Figma & Design System expertise: Deep, hands-on experience building, scaling, and architecting multi-platform design systems at the token and component level.

- Data-fluent mindset: Ability to read and rigorously interpret A/B testing data, distinguishing genuine impact from vanity metrics.

Pourquoi rejoindre la practice IA ?

Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe encadrée par Hamza Bouanani, Practice Manager IA chez MARGO, également Lead Data Scientist chez BNP Paribas.

Travailler à ses côtés, c’est intégrer une équipe d’experts passionnés, être challengé sur le plan technique et méthodologique, et contribuer à des projets à fort impact pour les clients.

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Chez Theodo GovTech, nous accompagnons nos clients - ministères, collectivités territoriales et grands opérateurs publics - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société.
Rejoindre notre aventure, c'est partager une ambition commune : utiliser le numérique pour augmenter l’efficacité de l'action publique et améliorer le quotidien des agents et des usagers. Ton équipe :

title: Business Development Professional
description: Aon Is Looking for a Business Development Professional I This is a virtual position, residence within the Midwest or Western region is highly preferred. As part of an industry‑leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions within our K&K Business Development/Sales group, focused on the Sports, Leisure, and Entertainment sector of Aon Affinity. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon , we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like: Grow production from existing K&K agents and brokers through regular visits and product updates Identify and target new agents and brokers within the Western territory and introduce company products and programs Secure submissions (applications) from agents and brokers Review submissions and forward to the home office Support home office underwriters throughout the underwriting process Prepare sales presentations, contracts, and proposals Present proposals to agents and brokers, respond to questions, and close new business Manage agent/broker relationships post‑sale and participate in the renewal process Focus on achieving personal sales targets and driving new business development Contribute to special projects, including new product launches and marketing initiatives Travel up to 50% of the time within the assigned region Residence within the Midwest or Western region is highly preferred Skills and experience that will lead to success: Minimum of 5 years of Property & Casualty (P&C) experience Valid P&C license Experience working in a highly regulated industry Proven sales, prospecting, business development, and relationship management experience, preferably in the insurance industry Working knowledge of P&C insurance products Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) Strong presentation skills Preferred experience: Working knowledge of Life, Accident, and Health products General understanding of risk exposures in the sports, leisure, and entertainment sector Knowledge of Salesforce Education: Bachelor’s degree in Insurance, Risk Management, Sales, or Marketing. Equivalent years of relevant industry experience will be considered in lieu of a degree For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $73,300 to $95,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon ’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon ’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar

title: Infrastructure Software Engineering – Platform & Build
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.   The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. The Role As an Infrastructure Platform Engineer you will be a core part of our technical team working alongside the hardware, software and research teams to solve cutting-edge problems in AI hardware, ranging from verification to simulation, alongside the best of the best (DeepMind, Apple, Meta…). About the Software organisation at Fractile Infrastructure sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems.
